newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Oct industrial output seen at 13.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: China's Oct industrial output seen at 13.7 pct.

text.p: China's industrial output is forecast to grow by 13.7 percent in October to 166 billion yuan for the month, the Financial News said on Tuesday.
The forecast by the State Information Centre expected industrial output growth at 13 percent for the first 10 months, or 1,526 billion yuan.
It said there was little likelihood of a major change in industrial output in the fourth quarter.
China's industrial output rose by 12.9 percent to 1,357.5 billion yuan in the first nine months of this year compared with the year-ago period, State Statistical Bureau figures showed.
Industrial output grew by 13.6 percent in the first quarter, 13.1 percent in the second quarter and 11.8 percent in the third quarter.
